messages:
Jordan: Quick async check-in from me this morning — tiny sprint update and a couple asks.
Jordan: Yesterday: landed metrics for the request batcher + merged infra PR #4271 (link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4271). Verified tokens/cost logging.
Jordan: Blocker: CI flake on windows runners (TestKVStoreConcurrent) is blocking the gosdk pipeline. failing fmt-check intermittently.
Jordan: Today: will kick off a canary for the nvme-backed nodes and run a short RPS load test. Planning to do the canary at ~08:15 UTC.
Jordan: Asks: @Nina — can you review PR #4278 (router changes)? you reviewed routing last month so your eyeballs would be great.
Nina: Yep, I can take it after standup. Quick heads-up: I saw a small cold-start perf regression in one of the new paths, left a note on the PR :eyes:.
Arjun: I can own the load test runs. Jordan drop the k8s job spec or job name and I'll queue the ramp. I have a reusable job template.
Jordan: Thanks @Arjun — adding job spec to the doc now (linking to the runbook). also attaching the curl we use for smoke: ```curl -X POST https://canary.redwood.internal/run -d '{"job":"batch-rps","duration":300}'```
deploy-bot: Canary started (canary-id=canary-2026-03-17-0815) — monitoring enabled, will report health in ~2m.
eng-infra: Noted the CI flake; we'll triage TestKVStoreConcurrent. If you can paste the failing log snippet in the ticket it helps.
sarah: I can spare an hour at 14:00 UTC to pair on the CI failure if that works for you @Jordan :calendar:.
Jordan: That would be perfect, @sarah — I'll create the invite and add the logs to ENG-3210.
Jordan: One last quick ask: if anyone from product is around, can we briefly confirm the rollback SLO for the router change? want to make sure the fallback path is clear.
Nina: pinged @product in the PR comments. I'll escalate if no reply in 30m.
Jordan: Thanks all — will post a short follow-up when the canary finishes.
